session_id.description: Ordinal index of the session within the participant, numbered in session order (e.g., 01, 02).

recording_id.description: Unique identifier for each recording; joins to phenotype/task/recording.tsv.

task_name.description: The audio task conducted for the recording.

word_index.description: Position of the word in the recording's consensus transcript, from 0

bracketed.description: Whether the word is a non-speech tag, e.g. [UH] or [COUGH]

start_s.description: Start of the word in the recording

end_s.description: End of the word in the recording

outcome.description: How the two recognisers' words aligned

agreement.description: Share of the recognisers that produced the word (1.0 both, 0.5 one)

crisperwhisper_text.description: CrisperWhisper's word; empty where it produced none

qwen_text.description: Qwen's word; empty where it produced none
